# Catalog

Every article, filed under its topics. An article with several topics appears under each one. Only the hubs are links; article titles are plain text, so the graph reaches an article through its hub.

## [[Personal ontology vault]]

The owner's private, git-backed knowledge base, read and grown by their Claude sessions and agents.

- Vault topics (Creative work): The controlled list of topics the vault's index is built on.
